body: - **Step 7a (architectural-guidelines)**: Consulted ARCHITECTURAL_GUIDELINES.md; one minor deviation identified — G-Cfg-1 (define every wire-literal once in `config.py`, aggregate rather than re-list): `python/larch/review/plan_review_loop.py` defines `TIMING_VENDOR_COLS = 13`, duplicating the existing `TIMING_VENDOR_MIN_COLS = 13` already defined in `python/larch/report/progress_report.py`. Both encode the same `v1 vendor` timing-ledger column-count wire literal used by the shared TSV grammar; if that row grammar ever changes, an editor could update one and miss the other. Non-blocking — read-only, single call site.
